title: Ara-150-Pipeline: AraForge pipeline and dialect-aware Arabic G2P engine
description: Rule-based grapheme-to-phoneme engine for Egyptian, Levantine and Gulf Arabic and MSA, its evaluation scripts and data, the human-evaluation judgments, and the scripts behind the paper "Rule-Based Phonemization for Arabic Dialects: A Grapheme-to-Phoneme Framework" (submitted to the Arabian Journal for Science and Engineering).
